hoy.titular: Eight days out from the final, Medina waits on Correa and settles Baltasar's replacement

foto.alt: Estudiantes' starting XI pose at the Maracanã before the semi-final against Flamengo.

hoy.resumen: Medina is weighing options to cover for Baltasar Rodríguez and waiting on Correa, who is in the final stage of his recovery. In Brazil, Abel is set to field an all-reserve side against Flamengo on Saturday.

siete.titulo: Palmeiras to field an all-reserve side against Flamengo
siete.texto: According to Band, Abel will name a team made up entirely of reserves on Saturday against Flamengo, who need only a draw to win the Brasileirão. On Tuesday 24th Palmeiras visit Chapecoense at 18:00, leaving them three days before the final.

siete.titulo: Correa in the final stretch of his recovery
siete.texto: He remains a doubt with the tear in his right hamstring, but according to El Día he is in the final stage of his recovery. The plan is for him to start; if he is not fully fit, he could come on in the second half, which would open the door for Cetré.

siete.titulo: Rojo on how he came back to the Pincha
siete.texto: Marcos Rojo revealed that the chance to return arose after the tie against Corinthians and named the people who were key to making it happen.

siete.titulo: A half-time show at the final
siete.texto: For the first time, the Copa Libertadores final will have a half-time show, CONMEBOL announced.

siete.titulo: The road map to the Centenario
siete.texto: The squad train in City Bell until Wednesday 25th (Sunday is a day off) and travel to Montevideo that afternoon, staying at the Hilton; on Thursday and Friday they will train at Montevideo City Torque's training ground.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar, Medina likely to stick with a back five
siete.texto: Baltasar Rodríguez, sent off against Flamengo, will miss the final. According to El Día, the main option is to repeat the three centre-backs and two wing-backs used at the Maracanã, with Tobio Burgos on the left; Diario Hoy names Fabricio Pérez, who started in the Supercopa Argentina, as an alternative.

siete.titulo: Around 35,000 Pincha fans head for Montevideo
siete.texto: 120 coaches are going: 60 laid on by the club, leaving the UNO on the afternoon of Friday 27th, and 60 from supporters' groups and branches. Friday and Saturday ferries are sold out, and 2009 champions invited by the club will also be at the Centenario.
